versions.subject: Wannacrypt Update
versions.detection:
selection1:
    # Requires group policy 'Audit Process Creation' > Include command line in process creation events
    EventID: 4688
    CommandLine:
        - '*vssadmin delete shadows*'
        - '*icacls * /grant Everyone:F /T /C /Q*'
        - '*bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled no*'
        - '*wbadmin delete catalog -quiet*'
selection2:
    # Does not require group policy 'Audit Process Creation' > Include command line in process creation events
    EventID: 4688
    NewProcessName:
        - '*\tasksche.exe'
        - '*\mssecsvc.exe'
        - '*\taskdl.exe'
        - '*\WanaDecryptor*'
        - '*\taskhsvc.exe'
        - '*\taskse.exe'
        - '*\111.exe'
        - '*\lhdfrgui.exe'
        - '*\diskpart.exe'  # Rare, but can be false positive
        - '*\linuxnew.exe'
        - '*\wannacry.exe'
condition: selection1 or selection2
versions.spl: (EventID=4688 CommandLine IN ("*vssadmin delete shadows*", "*icacls * /grant Everyone:F /T /C /Q*", "*bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled no*", "*wbadmin delete catalog -quiet*")) OR (EventID=4688 NewProcessName IN ("*\\tasksche.exe", "*\\mssecsvc.exe", "*\\taskdl.exe", "*\\WanaDecryptor*", "*\\taskhsvc.exe", "*\\taskse.exe", "*\\111.exe", "*\\lhdfrgui.exe", "*\\diskpart.exe", "*\\linuxnew.exe", "*\\wannacry.exe"))
